role_observations.executor: Five JSON command generations, two target-contract rejections and three successful searches. Every search used TODO|FIXME and returned zero matches, so the public endpoints and implementation were not read into observation evidence.

role_observations.finalizer_and_final_auditor: No generation occurred; capability is unobserved.
role_observations.state_behavior: Three clean Executor sessions; successive sessions project preceding action facts instead of inheriting Executor State. Auditor is separately bootstrapped and not merged.
